note: Real-time MuJoCo simulation on Mila (L40S, RTF ~0.99). Laptop runs slower than real time held the hands 3-4 cm closer and walked shorter; use this file for both but expect differences there.

camera.measured: 2026-10-29 MuJoCo model (head camera on torso_link, standing G1)
camera.rotation_note: columns: camera x (image right), y (image up), z (backwards) in the pelvis frame

balloon.measured: 2026-10-30 locate() vs ground truth, 68 standing frames: x err sd 1.0 cm, y err +1.0 cm mean, sd 1.9 cm

grab.measured: 2026-11-04 from 100 sim catches with a balloon (jobs 11455221-11526779): reach 2 held 77/81, every miss outside 0.38-0.52 m but two; reach 1 held 17/19 at 0.40-0.46 m. yaw_tracking from grab_report (no balloon), whose cradle centres (0.391/0.418) sit ~2.5 cm closer than where real grabs succeed

walk.measured: 2026-11-04 walk_report: 18 probes, 4 stalled; back walked 0.13 m in 0.62 s, back_fine walked 0.05 m in 1.5 s, forward walked 0.35 m in 0.62 s, forward_fine walked 0.16 m in 1.53 s, left walked 0.03 m in 1.04 s, right walked -0.02 m in 1.04 s

safety.note: Chosen limits, not measurements. Dead reckoning uses the commanded speeds plus coasts, an upper bound that read 9.4 m when the robot was 1.7 m from the start (fine walks move at a third of their commanded speed). The scripted person leads the robot ~3.7 m forward in a 300 s run, so the sim fence is effectively off; the robot's 1 m fence is covered by the unit tests.
